1/JBR – A Pinnacle of Architectural Luxury

An iconic addition to the Dubai skyline, 1/JBR stands as a symbol of unparalleled luxury, marking the entrance to the prestigious Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR). This stunning 43-story tower offers lavish apartments designed to deliver a living experience like no other. With its exceptional location, renowned address, and meticulously crafted interiors, 1/JBR is poised to redefine luxury beachfront living at the heart of JBR, Dubai.

Key Features & Highlights:

4 Bedrooms Plus Maid’s Room
Unit Size: 3,753.48 Sq. Ft
Direct Beach Access
Palm & Panoramic Dubai Eye and Sea Views
Vacant Soon
Expansive Balcony
Luxurious Furnishings
Renovated Property
Unique

Elegant, private, and thoughtfully designed, the apartments feature bespoke details, designer finishes, and custom glass facades. The spacious sundecks offer spectacular panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Palm Jumeirah, providing residents with an extraordinary coastal retreat.

The communal areas, including the lobby, swimming pool, and gym, reflect cutting-edge design and the highest standards of quality. Semi-private lifts, private lobbies, and VIP parking further emphasize the exclusivity of this prestigious residential tower.

Company Information:

Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
